facts.claim: Listed for Web Summit Lisbon 2026 (LIS26) on its own appearance page: AI Infinity, Brazil, AI & machine learning, a startup in the Growth track.
Its Web Summit pitch describes an "AI-Enabled Service" that designs and implements tailor-made AI solutions for clients; it does not say agents.

The company's own site, its home page (read 7 November 2026, 00:25 UTC): its website; and a description of what the company does: it builds and operates outsourced AI departments for mid-sized and large organisations (strategy, build, integration), "keeping the intellectual property owned by your company". It does not use the words "AI-Enabled Service" or "extension of your team".
